instruction: A candid outdoor full shot from a low angle captures a romantic embrace. On the left, the woman in the white long-sleeved dress (R1) leans against a white stone wall. On the right, the man in the patterned short-sleeved shirt (R2) stands very close, holding her face gently as they lean in to kiss. The scene is set against a black ornate metal fence under bright daylight.
